selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the importance of this treatise, even though it has some difficulties?
questions.answer: It says the work is still very important and special despite those problems.

questions.question: Whose earlier recognition of the treatise is mentioned?
questions.answer: Imam Ali’s earlier recognition is mentioned.

questions.question: What does it mean that Imam Ali directed people’s attention toward this work?
questions.answer: It means he pointed people to it as something valuable and worthy of notice.

questions.question: What trouble came from producing the book in secret?
questions.answer: It brought imprisonment.

questions.question: What is given as a main reason for their release?
questions.answer: The strength and victory of the book’s sacred truth is given as a main reason.

questions.question: What verse-related role does the treatise have?
questions.answer: It serves as an explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: How many main parts does the treatise have?
questions.answer: It has an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What does the Introduction contain?
questions.answer: It contains four important matters.

questions.question: Why does the writer say the Introduction became long?
questions.answer: He says its length shows there was a real need for that much explanation.

questions.question: What is the main message in the opening part of the passage about the treatise?
questions.answer: The message is that the work has great value even if it is not easy in every way.

questions.question: Who is named as having miraculously known of its coming?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What later events are used as evidence that the prediction was true?
questions.answer: The imprisonment connected to the book and the later acquittal are used as evidence.

questions.question: What led to the imprisonment?
questions.answer: The secret printing of the book led to it.

questions.question: What does the passage say the treatise is an explanation of?
questions.answer: It says the treatise explains the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What does the passage call it in relation to the larger work?
questions.answer: It calls it the Seventh Ray, also designated as the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What is the job of the First Station?
questions.answer: It contains the Arabic section of the explanation.

questions.question: What does the writer say about his intention for the Introduction’s length?
questions.answer: He says he did not mean to make it that long.

questions.question: How does the final verse connect with the rest of the passage?
questions.answer: It reminds readers that the whole discussion is tied to the purpose of worshipping Allah.

questions.question: In this passage, how is the treatise presented overall?
questions.answer: It is presented as a highly important religious work with special honor.

questions.question: Which honored person is mentioned as giving advance notice of the work?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What historical incident is brought in to support that claim?
questions.answer: The Denizli events are brought in as support.

questions.question: In that episode, what role did the hidden printing of the book play?
questions.answer: It was the reason they were imprisoned.

questions.question: According to the passage, what helped bring about that positive outcome?
questions.answer: The triumph of the book’s holy and powerful truth helped bring it about.

questions.question: What double identity does the treatise have in the passage?
questions.answer: It is both an explanation of the Supreme Verse and the Seventh Ray.
